Ben Gray

Not so long ago, Real Madrid won four successive Clásicos, but have currently lost six of their last seven meetings with Barcelona. Los Blancos are seeking to avoid three successive La Liga defeats in Catalonia for the first time since the infamous 5-0 in 2010.

Matches do not come any bigger than el Clásico so, ahead of this unmissable game, we have put together a preview, predictions, team news and TV guide.

Barcelona vs Real Madrid match info

Date: Sunday 25 October 2026. [...] Fede Valverde is set to continue at right-back, chosen over Denzel Dumfries and Trent Alexander-Arnold, this to accomodate Bernardo Silva in midfield. Ibrahima Konaté, Marc Cucurella and Aurélien Tchouaméni will return, having been rested on Wednesday.
